answer: Give every new identity a probationary lane: it may take only small, escrowed jobs, and its pay is held until a random peer re-checks the work, like a lotus that must root before it blooms. A sybil farm in the tundra of fresh accounts then earns pennies per identity while paying full escrow and re-check costs on each one. Publish every attestation in a sable-dark public ledger so peers can spot a cluster of newborn identities acting in lockstep and throttle the whole cluster before it can touch grading or voting.
